Atlases renamed to snake_case

Source: R/deprecated.R
ggsegHO-deprecated.Rd

The two FSL Harvard-Oxford atlases were the only ones in this package named in camelCase. They now match the HOA-2 atlases and the rest of the ggsegverse:

  • hoCort() is now ho_cort()

  • hoSub() is now ho_sub()

The old names still return the same atlas, with a warning.

Usage

hoCort()

hoSub()

Value

The renamed atlas, invisibly identical to what the new name returns.
